title: Q-Learning on FrozenLake
learning_objectives: Train a tabular Q-learning agent on gymnasium's FrozenLake-v1
Explore with a decaying epsilon and break ties between equal Q-values randomly
Evaluate the greedy policy by its success rate on new episodes
entry_point: q_learning(env, episodes, alpha=0.1, gamma=0.99, eps_min=0.05, seed=0); success_rate(env, Q, episodes=200, seed=10000)
hints: `target = r + (0.0 if terminated else gamma * Q[next_obs].max())`; `Q[obs, a] += alpha * (target - Q[obs, a])`.
In `success_rate`, add the final reward of each episode and divide by the number of episodes.

failure_feedback.advice: Break ties randomly among maximal actions and decay epsilon.
Do not bootstrap from terminal states; their rows stay at zero.
Seed the generator and each env.reset(seed=seed + ep).
success_rate uses argmax of Q and counts the final reward.
